findings.message: This flips the default behaviour of an already-shipped operator: rejection used to fail the task (downstream `upstream_failed`) and now silently skips downstream instead, with `fail_on_reject=False` as the default. That needs a newsfragment/changelog entry for the provider so existing DAGs relying on the failure semantics aren't surprised on upgrade.

`fail_on_reject` is only consulted on the `require_approval=True` resume path, so setting it with `require_approval=False` is silently a no-op. Worth either validating that combination in `__init__` or calling it out explicitly in the docstring.
